# SportTek

> Pakistan’s sports booking platform for padel, cricket, futsal and more.

- Site: https://sporttek.pk
- Book courts: https://sporttek.pk/play
- Padel: https://sporttek.pk/padel
- Cricket: https://sporttek.pk/cricket
- Futsal: https://sporttek.pk/futsal
- Sports booking: https://sporttek.pk/sports-booking
- Contact: info@sporttek.pk
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/sporttek.pk

SportTek helps players find venues, compare slots and prices in PKR, and book online.
